# CANDIDATE: ORB_VWAP_FADE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After an opening range break, price often reverts to the intraday VWAP as liquidity rebalances, offering a fade opportunity. This edge exists because initial breaks may be driven by short-term order flow imbalances that correct as the market digests liquidity, particularly when volume deteriorates on the retest.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If price breaks above the opening range high (ORH) within the first 15 minutes and then closes two consecutive 1-minute bars below the intraday VWAP while the volume on those bars is below the average volume of the first 15 minutes, enter long at the close of the second bar; for short, mirror below the opening range low (ORL) and close above VWAP. Exit shape: Chart-stop at the opposite side of the opening range (ORL for long, ORH for short) or 0.5R, whichever is hit first; TP1 at 1R; runner trail using a chandelier exit at 2.5 ATR. Regime hint: Best when VIX < 15 and during the first 60 minutes; avoid when VIX > 20 or during major news (FOMC). Also require opening range width < 0.3% of price to filter choppy conditions.
